main_body: steel column with top capital, ribbed shaft, and base
top_band: light grey top surface from row 9 to row 11, with a brighter front edge highlight at row 12
evidence: The column capital shows a 3-row light grey top plane (rows 9-11) bounded by a 1-row lighter front-edge highlight at row 12, followed by the front face of the capital (row 13 with dark rivets) and a dark overhang/eave shadow (rows 14-16) above the vertical ribbed shaft (rows 17-40) and base (rows 41-47).
